title: ABA routing-number structural test vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of 9-digit ABA routing number candidates paired with structural rejection reasons. Tests the Swift RoutingNumberDetector ABA checksum (weights 3-7-1-3-7-1-3-7-1, sum mod 10 = 0) and valid first-two-digit prefix enforcement (ranges 01-12, 21-32, 61-72, 80).

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one routing number candidate with its expected structural verdict.

valid.description: Whether the candidate passes the ABA structural gates (prefix + checksum). Detector semantics: a valid candidate is emitted even without context, at base confidence — context only moves the confidence band.

rejection_reason.description: Which structural rule rejects this candidate, or null if valid.

has_context.description: Whether a routing context keyword is present near the number. False candidates have no keyword and test the base-confidence gate.

context_keyword.description: The routing context keyword paired with this candidate, or null when has_context is false.

notes.description: Human-readable note describing the test vector's intent.
